data_description.mfa_totp: MFA TOTP Seed - only required if using MFA
data_description.electric_rate: Optional. SmartHub does not report cost, so enter your price per kWh to generate a cost statistic for the Energy dashboard. Leave blank for no cost tracking.
data_description.electric_base_charge: Optional. Fixed monthly charge billed regardless of usage (service availability / base / meter charge). Spread across the month so cost totals match your bill.
data_description.water_rate: Optional. Enter your price per gallon to generate a water cost statistic. Leave blank for no cost tracking.
data_description.water_base_charge: Optional. Fixed monthly water charge billed regardless of usage. If sewer is billed on water volume, include the sewer base charge here too.
